title: Easter Sunday: The Resurrection Miracle
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner on this Easter Sunday as he delves into the heart of the gospel message, reminding us that Christ's resurrection is the cornerstone of our faith and the key to true freedom. In 1 Corinthians 15, Pastor Chris will help us understand the significance of Easter and how it should transform our lives with the power of the risen Christ. Don't miss this powerful message that will leave you rejoicing in the hope of eternal life!
